name: deploy
_comment: Publishes the site after a landing: trunk check-ins only (quarry_when default-branch), never a branch or a landing's merge. The tests run again first, because an accept onto a trunk that moved since the merge was tested puts an untested tree on trunk. pikchr-studio.deploy is claimed only by the deploy runner, which holds the Cloudflare token and itself refuses any check-in that is not on trunk (quarry runner --branch trunk). A Re-run of an older trunk check-in deploys that check-in: the rollback.
